# Knack

> Knack is an AI-powered no-code application development platform enabling businesses to build custom software solutions without coding.

Knack provides industry-specific and general-purpose application templates for work orders, project management, CRM, inventory, healthcare, construction, government, and more. The platform emphasizes rapid deployment, workflow automation, and data management across diverse business sectors.

## Key Topics

- No-Code Platform
- AI-Powered App Builder
- Workflow Automation
- Custom CRM
- Database Management
- Project Management
- Inventory Management
- Healthcare (HIPAA-Compliant)
- Construction Management
- Government Solutions
- Customer Portal
- Business Operations
- Supply Chain Management
- Asset Management
- Work Order Management

## Platform Overview

- [Knack: No-Code Application Development Platform](https://www.knack.com): Knack no-code platform for building robust applications and business solutions
- [Leverage Knack's App Builder to Build Solutions in Minutes](https://pages.knack.com/new-customer-offer): New customer offer highlighting Knack's AI-powered app builder capabilities
